Name: Mini Thermal Power Plants
Author: Ellindsey
Description:
Tired of the randomness of getting batteries from lightning rods, but haven't unlocked solar panels yet? This mod adds two new miniature power plants which generate a constant supply of batteries for you year-round.

The miniature coal power plant takes five coal as fuel and takes five days to generate one battery. The recipe will be sent to you by Clint once you have reached six hearts with him, are at mining level five, and are not in the first year of your farm.

Building the mini coal plant requires:
99 stone
10 limestone,
10 dolomite
10 basalt

These materials shouldn't be too hard to source if you've been gathering omni geodes.

The miniature nuclear power plant does not require refueling for the life of your farm. The recipe to build it is purchased from Mr. Qi's shop for 20 Qi gems. It's an late game item, but so is the solar panel.

Building the mini nuclear power plant requires:
99 stone
10 Radioactive Bar
10 Neptunite
10 Bixite

The radioactive bars aren't easy to source, but once you've done so, this produces free batteries forever.

Both of these power plants can be placed indoors or outdoors, so if you really want to have a basement full of nuclear reactors you can do so. I personally prefer to put them in the quarry, just cause it seems safer and more sensible.
